case.selection_rule: Smallest numeric public D2 scenario, selected before solve-quality inspection.
case.initialization: Cold from raw source conditions only; no supplied POP or saved solution.

quality_target.note: Comparison with published scores, not a global-optimality certificate.

host_memory.scope: Global host availability; resource stop, not an infeasibility proof

preflight.setup_exclusions: Dependency installation, package precompilation, source registration, checkout and download only. Runtime process import/JIT, raw loading, preprocessing and case factors included.
preflight.initialization: Cold; source conditions only, no POP or saved optimized solutions
preflight.benchmark_kind: One local cold attempt, 7200-second target and 7200-second safety limit; not an official competition submission

quality_target.note: Comparison with published scores, not a global-optimality certificate.

intermediate_verification_skipped.reason: Aggregate schedule with source voltages is explicitly unverified; protect final exhaustive check

last_host_memory.scope: Global host availability; resource stop, not an infeasibility proof

cpu_measurement_note: Sampled process CPU and sum of RSS, not allocator peak; shared pages may be counted twice.
